notes: Frame cards give a pitch its SHAPE (whose eyes, what scale, what genre feel); stances give the writers' room its editorial posture for the night. Dealt by python (OTR_FABLE2_SEED reproducible); the P1 pitch pass copies card names verbatim into PitchSlate.frame_card. SFW deck law: no weapons, no horror, no smoking -- deck-lint test enforced.

cards.name: The Night Operator
cards.shape: Told through the one person on duty when the anomaly arrives; a small room against a very large sky; intimate procedural.

cards.name: Two Rooms Apart
cards.shape: Two characters who never share a scene, joined only by a channel -- a wire, a pipe, a wall; the drama lives in the relay.

cards.name: The Last Reading
cards.shape: An instrument gives its final measurement; the story is who believes it and what believing costs; quiet suspense.

cards.name: The Understudy
cards.shape: Seen by the assistant who knows the machine better than its celebrated inventor; loyalty against credit; chamber drama.

cards.name: Small Town, Big Signal
cards.shape: A rural community absorbs a discovery meant for capitals; kitchen and general store scale; warm ensemble comedy of manners.

cards.name: The Long Wait
cards.shape: The discovery is slow -- a signal, a growth, a thaw -- and patience is the drama; scenes marked by what has not yet happened.

cards.name: The Committee of Two
cards.shape: A decision that should take an institution falls to two people at a table after hours; civic stakes at domestic scale.

cards.name: Letters Ahead
cards.shape: Messages arrive out of their proper order; the science bends distance or delay; a correspondence story with a fold in it.

cards.name: The Caretaker's Clause
cards.shape: Someone maintains a machine they were told never to understand; duty against curiosity; a slow domestic mystery.

cards.name: Homecoming Orbit
cards.shape: A traveler returns changed by the science while home has stayed still; reunion drama where the distance is the antagonist.

cards.name: The Borrowed Voice
cards.shape: The science lets one person speak with or for another; ownership of words; two-hander built on who is really talking.

cards.name: The Quiet Audit
cards.shape: An inspector arrives to close a project the very night it finally works; paperwork against wonder; deadpan procedural.

cards.name: The Apprentice's Number
cards.shape: A junior's small correction to a great calculation; pride against proof; a duel fought entirely in politeness.

cards.name: The Far Shore Relay
cards.shape: A chain of strangers must hand a fragile signal along, each link one scene; an ensemble story about trust between people who never meet.

stances.name: Wonder first
stances.note: Lead with awe; let the cost arrive quietly and late. The science is beautiful before it is trouble.

stances.name: Kitchen-table stakes
stances.note: Keep the science at the scale of one household: a bill, a letter, a chair left empty. Cosmic causes, domestic effects.

stances.name: Procedural calm
stances.note: Professionals doing procedure while the extraordinary leaks in at the edges; nobody raises their voice until the last scene.

stances.name: Elegiac
stances.note: Something true is ending; the discovery is also the goodbye. Warm, unhurried, no bitterness.

stances.name: Wry
stances.note: The anthology host's raised eyebrow; irony over alarm; the joke lands softly and the sting arrives a beat later.

stances.name: Hearth and static
stances.note: Intimacy against distance: voices close to the microphone, the cosmos far away; the smaller the room, the bigger the sky.
